fact: IPC-IG and WFP say that in Maputo, Zambezia, Tete and Cabo Delgado the government's INAS-IP PASD-PE COVID-19 transfers were paid electronically into Vodacom M-PESA mobile wallets.
World Bank says over 200,000 PASD-PE beneficiaries were paid digitally by March 2023, into M-Pesa mobile money accounts through the government's automated payment system (SPA).
